tool_args.rationale: The supply-bullwhip bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the fixed-gradient pilot cannot identify sink inhibition or reliably distinguish its open branch. The open-branch probe directly resolves that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so the sink coefficient and branch mechanisms are not identifiable from them.
The bridge and flux signatures point first to a static siphon; a trajectory batch is more costly and is not yet justified.
Both remain plausible alternatives at a single gradient and require gradient-discriminating observations.
